description: ONS publishes daily natural inflow energy (ENA) aggregated by reservoir. Gross ENA converts natural reservoir inflows into producible electricity using productivity at 65% of useful storage. Storable ENA deducts spilled flows. The dictionary includes gross and storable values and percentages relative to long-term means. ONS identifies energy studies and marginal-operation-cost projection as uses. These indicators support hydrothermal dispatch modelling. This is a computed energy indicator, not raw flow. Other ENA groupings aggregate the same underlying system and must not be counted as independent measurements. Coverage is reservoir groups in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
